assignments.reason: The enlargement of Chassadim (הגדלת החסדים) is, by essential nature, an expression of Chassadim — the core sefirotic domain of Package 1. The package already contains the compound node 'התלבשות הדעת בחסדים' and the additions file adds 'חסדים' as a standalone node. הגדלת החסדים is Chassadim in its dynamic, growing form — the same essential reality as the Chesed/Avraham domain, not a separate concept.

The Rebbe explicitly states 'מִתְפַּתֶּה דַּיְקָא, בְּחִינַת חֲסָדִים' — being appeased/persuaded IS a bechina of Chassadim. The additions file already identifies מתפתה as belonging to Package 1 on this basis. This node (מתפתה ומתפיס) is the same concept in its fuller form (being appeased and appeasing), squarely within the Chassadim/Chesed domain.

This node ('when Da'at is elevated') is Da'at in its elevated state. Its essential nature is Da'at — the dominant node and core sefirotic identity of Package 1. The Rebbe teaches that Moshe IS Da'at and Da'at IS clothed in Chassadim; the elevation of Da'at is the elevation of the very reality the package describes.

This node ('Chassadim are elevated and enlarged') is Chassadim in their growing, dynamic state. Essential nature: Chassadim. Same domain as הגדלת החסדים and the core Chassadim reality of Package 1 (Avraham/248 limbs/Chesed). The text states: 'כְּשֶׁנִּתְרוֹמֵם הַדַּעַת, נִתְרוֹמְמִין וְנִגְדָּלִין הַחֲסָדִים, כִּי הַדַּעַת מְלֻבָּשׁ בָּחֲסָדִים' — confirming this is the Chassadim side of the Da'at-Chassadim unity.

This node ('his Da'at expands and his mind is elevated') is Da'at in its expanded, elevated form. Essential nature: Da'at — the dominant node of Package 1. The expansion of Da'at is described as the mechanism through which Chassadim grow ('כְּשֶׁנִּתְרוֹמֵם הַדַּעַת, נִתְרוֹמְמִין וְנִגְדָּלִין הַחֲסָדִים'), placing it firmly within the Da'at/Moshe domain.

This node ('to broaden his Da'at') is the broadening of Da'at — the same essential Da'at reality as the package's dominant node. The Torah opens by stating that moderate drinking is 'טוֹבָה לְהַרְחִיב דַּעְתּוֹ' — good for broadening Da'at. The concept's core identity is Da'at, not the drinking that produces it.

unassigned_nodes.reason: Wine is a neutral physical substance that can serve either the good or the evil domain. In this Torah, moderate wine produces expansion of Da'at and enlargement of Chassadim (good), while excessive wine produces Gevurot d'Sitra Achra and anger (evil). Wine itself has no inherent sefirotic identity — it is the instrument, not the essence. It does not share the essential nature of Da'at/Chassadim/Moshe/Avraham, and there is no evil bechina package to assign it to either. It remains unassigned.

A small amount of drinking as needed is a practical action — the eitza (advice) itself. Its essential nature is behavioral/practical (measured consumption), not sefirotic. While oriented toward good outcomes, the act of moderate drinking is not itself an expression of Da'at or Chassadim; it is the cause that produces them. It does not share the essential identity of any existing package.

Drinking in proper measure according to one's capacity is a practical action-condition, essentially the same domain as 'מעט השתיה לפי הצרך'. Its essential nature is behavioral — the act of measured drinking — not an expression of Da'at or Chassadim. It is the cause that leads to Da'at expansion, not Da'at itself. No existing package matches its essential nature.
